title: Muzaffarnagar House Collapse Kills Seven, Including Four Children
summary: A house made of mud collapsed in a village in Muzaffarnagar district on Sunday night, killing seven people, including four children. The incident occurred during a heavy rainstorm and the family was eating dinner when the collapse happened.
summary_points: A house made of mud collapsed in a village in Muzaffarnagar district
The incident killed seven people, including four children
The collapse occurred during a heavy rainstorm
The family was eating dinner when the collapse happened
The cause of the collapse is not specified
title_hi: मुज़फ्फरनगर में बारिश से कच्चा मकान ढहा, पांच बच्चों की मौत

summary_points_hi: मुज़फ्फरनगर जिले के हबीबपुर सीकरी गांव में बारिश के दौरान कच्चा मकान ढहा

framing.right: Right-leaning outlets focus on the potential causes of the collapse, such as poor construction or inadequate infrastructure. They also mention the government's response to the disaster.
